camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeUuidsByVulNames --region cn-hangzhou --StatusList '1,2' --Necessity 'asap,later,nntf' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1 --Lang zh --Dealed n --GroupId 11286014 --Remark '10.7.' --Type cve --VulNames.1 'centos:8:rhsa-2020:1665' --TargetType uuid --SearchTags oval --Level 'high,low' --Tag oval --FieldValue 'cas-adad-qeqwe' --VpcInstanceIds 'vpc-uf6ssrvbrwe37ekw0000,vpc-bp1aevy8sofi8mh1q0000' --FieldName namespace
description_en: Retrieves the list of servers that support vulnerability fixing based on vulnerability names
description_zh: 根据漏洞名称获取支持修复的机器列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-uuids-by-vul-names --lang zh --type cve --status-list 1,2 --tag oval --level high,low --dealed n --group-id 11286014 --vpc-instance-ids vpc-uf6ssrvbrwe37ekw0000,vpc-bp1aevy8sofi8mh1q0000 --remark 10.7. --search-tags oval --field-name namespace --field-value cas-adad-qeqwe --target-type uuid --necessity asap,later,nntf --vul-names centos:8:rhsa-2020:1665 --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUuidsByVulNames

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of vulnerability to query. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：

cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

1: unfixed
2: fix failed
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。多个修复状态使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

1：未修复
2：修复失败
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability level. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

high: high
medium: medium
low: low

low：低危
